data.description: 【伊冯 · 终末地遗迹】终末地的废弃遗迹里，伊冯踩着断壁一跃而下，双枪在指尖转出残影，粉色发梢在风里划出弧线——「遗迹里的旧科技，就该由本天才来回收利用！」
data.promptProse: Yvonne leaps down from a broken wall in the abandoned Endfield ruins, turning both handguns in her gloved fingers. Pink twin tails arc behind her initial combat outfit as the wide view preserves the landing space below. Fractured walls overlap farther back through dusty air. Daylight from the open ruin roof lights her sleeves and gun edges, while the broken masonry casts angular shadows across her descent.
data.title: 伊冯 · 终末地遗迹
